QUOTE: "`mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` carves allocations out of a caller-supplied static buffer. It then calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()` to install its own calloc and free as the global pointers (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-576`)."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the buffer allocator's init function installing itself via the runtime setter. It doesn't say "only in-tree user" literally, but it calls it "the library's own allocator… a consumer of this mechanism," and it found no other callers.
